4.t: And by the Night when it passeth away;-

5.t: Is there (not) in these an adjuration (or evidence) for those who understand?

6.t: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the 'Ad (people),-

7.t: Of the (city of) Iram, with lofty pillars,

8.t: The like of which were not produced in (all) the land?

9.t: And with the Thamud (people), who cut out (huge) rocks in the valley?-

10.t: And with Pharaoh, lord of stakes?

11.t: (All) these transgressed beyond bounds in the lands,

13.t: Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements:

14.t: For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower.

15.t: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me."

16.t: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"

17.t: Nay, nay! but ye honour not the orphans!

18.t: Nor do ye encourage one another to feed the poor!-

19.t: And ye devour inheritance - all with greed,

20.t: And ye love wealth with inordinate love!

21.t: Nay! When the earth is pounded to powder,

22.t: And thy Lord cometh, and His angels, rank upon rank,

23.t: And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him?

24.t: He will say: "Ah! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my (Future) Life!"

25.t: For, that Day, His Chastisement will be such as none (else) can inflict,

26.t: And His bonds will be such as none (other) can bind.

27.t: (To the righteous soul will be said:) "O (thou) soul, in (complete) rest and satisfaction!

28.t: "Come back thou to thy Lord,- well pleased (thyself), and well-pleasing unto Him!
